description: Hand-labeled SWER sanity set. Fill asr_hypothesis and ground_truth from real Whisper and Wav2Vec2 outputs, then set ready=true.

severity_labels.cosmetic: Fluent or filler error; no clinical meaning change.
severity_labels.moderate: Meaning shifted but not a dangerous clinical swap.
severity_labels.clinically_dangerous: Negation flip, drug/dose swap, opposite finding, or fully destroyed critical span.
